description: My name is Ella, and I'm an aspiring robotic engineer. I have been interested in NASA since I knew about it, and this challenge was a boost, so join my team if you are interested in NASA and their robots.
summary: I developed a website . This website contains  description of few robots listed and also an article. it addresses the challenge by educating people on these abandoned equipment and their achievements.
details: the project is a website containing an article created for the NASA apps challenge. The project educates or enlightens people about the abandoned equipment to preserve honor and legacy of these robots, rovers and equipment left behind so it does not get forgotten. the tools used for this project are HTML, CSS and JAVA script. I used the VS studio code software to develop my project and deployed live as Github, my projects increases and impacts knowledge on people about these abandoned rovers and equipment. my team is solo so the factors i considered where users experience, technical execution and deployment and submission requirements. Thank you.
